items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I went in there and I worked I guess about a week, with Eddie Shu ... so I met him.

ctx.x: What was the name of that? I don't remember that.

I can't remember the name of the club. I think it was the Celebrity Club. But when I came back out here, and I was getting these one nighters and things, the Clef Club was open at that time. And I went in there and I worked I guess about a week, with Eddie Shu , and Art Blakey had just closed, and Eddie Shu followed him in, playing the saxophone and harmonica, and Lenny Bruce was on the bill, so I met him. And later Kenny Drew, the pianist, took me out to his house, and I met his wife, and they had a newborn…
